products.name: Asana AI
products.note: Work management AI; goal tracking; team productivity analytics; data residency options

reading.body:
Asana, a work management platform founded in 2008, has positioned itself as infrastructure for teams coordinating with AI agents rather than only with humans, building AI capabilities into task tracking and workflow automation.

Work management software sits upstream of compute consumption because every workflow it orchestrates can now involve AI agents alongside humans. Asana's framing around "Agentic Work Management" suggests the company views AI not as a feature but as a new category of worker whose coordination demands reshape how software should be built. If teams and AI agents operate workflows together at scale, the platform's data residency options and memory systems become material to how much compute those workflows require and where that compute runs.

The data describes Asana's AI products but does not include metrics on adoption, agent usage volume, or whether customers have actually deployed the features at scale. It also does not show whether Asana's infrastructure choices create genuine constraints on compute efficiency or data movement, or whether the "Work Graph" it describes in practice reduces or increases the total compute required to run a team. The distinction matters: coordinating agents more efficiently could lower compute demand, while logging every task and preference could raise it.

profile_text.body:
Asana is a publicly traded work and project management software company (ticker: ASAN, CIK: 0001477720) founded in 2008. Its platform is designed for teams and, as its site now emphasizes, AI agents working alongside them. The company describes its offering as enabling teams to plan, automate, and execute critical workflows together, with a feature set built around what it calls the Work Graph, a shared memory layer that it says allows AI components to carry forward completed tasks, feedback, and preferences so that workflows improve over time without users repeating context.

The company's AI product, tracked here as Asana AI, sits within the notes, knowledge, and meetings category and covers work management, goal tracking, team productivity analytics, and data residency options. Its site describes a suite it calls Agentic Work Management, which brings together pre-built AI agents it terms AI Teammates, a builder called AI Studio, a dashboard called Asana Dash, and MCP and AI Connectors. Users can also create custom AI Teammates from their team's existing expertise to handle coordination-heavy work. No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings beyond standard public-company registration are reflected in the held facts for this entry.
